description: Browse the directory of MCP servers relevant to online stores and agencies. Filter by category, access level, vendor-published only, or a free-text query. Returns summaries; use get_server for depth.

access.description: Limit to servers with this access level. Read-only is the safest starting point.

category.description: Limit to one directory category, for example Advertising, Analytics, Email and CRM, Payments, Support and reviews, SEO or Agency operations.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return, 1 to 60. Defaults to 60.

official_only.description: When true, return only servers published by the vendor itself and skip community projects.

query.description: Free text matched against server name, vendor, summary and category, for example 'google ads' or 'helpdesk'.

name: list_servers

access.description: Read-only, Read and write, or Varies by tool

status.description: GA, beta, preview, community or unverified

title: List MCP servers for e-commerce
